description: This file contains unit tests for the WorkActivityStore component, testing various job and tool handling scenarios, icon state updates, and label extraction logic within the Swift application.

classes.name: WorkActivityStoreTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the behavior of the WorkActivityStore, including job handling, tool processing, icon state updates, and label extraction.

methods.name: main session job preempts other
methods.description: Tests that a new 'started' job preempts an existing one and updates the icon state accordingly.

methods.name: job stays working after tool result grace
methods.description: Verifies that the work icon remains in a working state after a tool completes and the job is marked as done.

methods.name: tool label extracts first line and shortens home
methods.description: Checks that the tool label correctly extracts the first line of command output and shortens paths relative to the home directory.

methods.name: resolve icon state honors override selection
methods.description: Ensures that explicit icon state overrides are respected by the store.
